insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 6 G3+ games, 24/30 picks (80%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 14 champs in G1s, 24 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ezreal? They go Caitlyn
insights.text: Ezreal is a G1 favorite (4/4 G1s, played by Scary Jerry). In the 10 later games where it was burned or banned, Scary Jerry went to Caitlyn (3/10) and Ashe (2/10).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Vi is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Vi in 8/14 games (57%): 2 picks (1-1) and 6 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Nocturne against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Nocturne against them in 7/14 games (50%).
